# TAMA.BIN 0x27700: the egg room speech bubble text (sprite pattern 0x14, 192x24, 4 bits per pixel).
# Was: たまごをえらんでね (choose an egg). One hex digit per pixel = palette colour: F white (bubble), 9 dark brown (A = the original's soft brown edge, unused).
# Drawn with the game's own bold font (USER.BIN 0x7000, as patched), centred; generated by the command in README.md's notes.
